title: SUFFOC Juniors retain the Yvette Baker Shield
text: Congratulations to our juniors who retained the Yvette Baker Shield at the Yvette Baker Trophy Final at Sandal Beat Wood in Doncaster on Sunday 9th July 2023. SUFFOC secured a maximum 500 points with Olivia Radcliffe, Ben Clarke, Elizabeth Rigby, Ethan Radcliffe and Aaron Radcliffe winning their classes.
